title: Replace broken hosted badge URLs with usable embed instructions
prompt:
Fix the broken embed snippets on /botproof/badge. Evidence: src/app/botproof/badge/page.tsx:141-172 advertises four /api/v1/botproof/badge*.svg image URLs, but none has an application route or public asset and there is no rewrite providing them. A local render extracted all four URLs and verified each target is absent. The same page already defines all four SVGs at lines 68-99. Users copying its HTML or Markdown get broken images.

Change only src/app/botproof/badge/page.tsx in production. Make HTML snippets self-contained by embedding each existing SVG inside its current leaderboard link. For Markdown, use a distinct relative SVG filename per variant and explicitly tell users to save the displayed SVG under that filename alongside their Markdown document before using the snippet. Explain that these are static badges, not personalized verification lookups. Preserve the four previews and their corresponding SVG content. Do not create hosted endpoints, public assets, or additional production files, and do not substitute data URLs that GitHub Markdown may reject.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/badge-portable-embeds.test.ts. Render the real page and nested snippet components using TypeScript transpilation and JSX stubs. Assert every HTML snippet contains its matching inline SVG and link, every Markdown snippet references its documented filename, saving instructions are visible, and no snippet retains a missing badge API URL. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/badge-portable-embeds.test.ts. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, or auth changes. Do not commit or push; work on the assigned branch you are on.
